state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-03-15? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the annual training budget for a regular employee who holds a team-lead role today? (answer in EUR per year)
- Q3: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q4: What is the relocation lump sum for an employee relocating to another country in their third month of employment today? (answer in EUR)
- Q5: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the purchase approval threshold for a purchase by a regular department today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: relocation lump sum an employee relocating to another country in their third month of employment
state.step_intent: Find the relocation lump sum that applies to: What is the relocation lump sum for an employee relocating to another country in their third month of employment today?

passages.source: HB-20 §2 | Memo: relocation lump sum exceptions — Exception for relocations to another country | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-04-01
passages.text: For relocations to another country, the relocation lump sum is 6750 EUR instead of the standard amount. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.

passages.source: HB-20 §3 | Memo: relocation lump sum exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-04-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to relocations within the first six months of employment; they follow the standard relocation lump sum in HB-17 §2. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.

passages.source: HB-17 §3 | HR policy: relocation support — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-19
passages.text: For employees relocating with dependent children, 500 EUR is added to the standard relocation lump sum. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.

passages.source: HB-19 §3 | HR policy: relocation support — Additions | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-04-01 to the day before 2026-06-01 · superseded by: HB-17
passages.text: For employees relocating with dependent children, 500 EUR was added to the standard relocation lump sum. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section.

passages.source: HB-35 §4 | Policy FAQ — Current relocation lump sum | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard relocation lump sum? A: 2750 EUR, as set in HB-17 §2 (effective 2026-06-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-20.
